subject: SOC 2 evidence packet request — key rotation, SAML assertions, MFA log slices
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sentinelhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@sentinelhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II evidence packet & supplemental artifacts request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of Sentinel Health's vendor security review (SOC 2 Type II), our internal audit team needs a short packet of supplemental artifacts to complete our control testing and prepare the bridge letter. Please provide the following (for the SOC 2 audit period Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026):

- Key rotation summary for all production KMS keys used to protect customer data (rotation dates, owners, and verification logs)
- Samples of SAML assertions and an explanation of any custom attributes used in the SSO integration
- A 24-hour slice of MFA verification logs for the audit window (pseudonymized usernames acceptable) with timestamps and outcome codes
- Recent access recertification evidence for privileged accounts (owner sign-offs, dates)
- Status of any bridge letter or attestation you can provide (date and signer)

We prefer redacted/sampled artifacts rather than full raw exports. Would you be able to deliver these within seven business days (by 2026-11-10)? I've attached our vendor questionnaire for completeness (sentinel_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx).

If you need clarification on formats or acceptable redactions, ping me and our audits team can provide examples.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Sr. Procurement & Audit Manager
Sentinel Health

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence packet & supplemental artifacts request

Thanks Marta — and thanks for sending the questionnaire. We're happy to provide the artifacts. A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope the deliverable correctly: 

1) For the MFA logs, do you need a contiguous 24-hour window (UTC) or a business-hours slice? We can provide either; contiguous UTC slices are easier to extract.
2) For key rotation, do you want KMS rotation history only for customer-facing production keys, or also internal platform keys (e.g., build system keys)?
3) For privileged access recertifications, would a signed spreadsheet (owner/date/comments) plus the audit trail link be sufficient, or do you need the original access review emails?

Tentative plan: Laura will assemble the key-rotation summary and SAML assertion samples. Karthik will prepare the MFA log slice (pseudonymized) and access recert artifacts. We'll aim to deliver the packet by end of day 2026-11-08, which gives a couple of days buffer from your 11/10 target. If you confirm the audit window and preferred MFA slice style, we'll proceed.

Also, we can include a draft bridge letter for your legal team to review — would you prefer a signed PDF or an unsigned draft first?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence packet & supplemental artifacts request

Hi Marta — looping in the technical artifacts here. Per Jonas's note, we've prepared a sampled evidence packet. Attached: redwood_key_rotation_summary_2025-2026.pdf, saml_assertion_samples.txt, redwood_mfa_log_sample_202610.csv, and a draft bridge letter (redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf).

Summary of what's included and how we prepared it:

- Key rotation summary (attached PDF)
  - Covers production KMS keys used for customer data encryption (not CI/build keys).
  - For each key: key ID (redacted prefix), rotation dates, approving owner, and an excerpt of verification logs showing the rotate operation timestamp.
  - Logs in the summary are hashed and truncated to protect key material and operator identities; full audit trails are available under NDA if needed.

- SAML assertion samples (saml_assertion_samples.txt)
  - We include three assertions from our test environment that match production attribute mappings (NameID, email, groups, role).
  - Attributes with PII are redacted; we provide the schema and descriptions for custom attributes used in provisioning.

- MFA log sample (redwood_mfa_log_sample_202610.csv)
  - This is a 24-hour UTC slice from 2026-10-20 (representative of the audit period) containing: event_time (UTC), pseudonym_user_id (hashed), device_type, method (TOTP/push), outcome (success/failure), and geo_region.
  - We replaced raw user identifiers with stable pseudonyms to preserve the structure for testing while protecting user privacy. If you need original user IDs under an executed DPA/NDA amendment, we can discuss that channel.

- Access recertification evidence
  - Attached is a signed spreadsheet extract of privileged account recertifications for Q4 2025 — Q1 2026 with owner sign-offs. We also provide links to the internal access review tickets and timestamps.

- Bridge letter draft
  - The draft bridge letter notes that Redwood's Type II report covers Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026 and references the included artifacts. It's unsigned in this draft. If the letter format looks good, Jonas can sign and we can deliver a signed PDF within 48 hours.

Delivery notes and caveats:

- Redaction policy: All artifacts are sampled/redacted to remove direct customer identifiers; we preserved control evidence (timestamps, action/actor meta, and hashes) so you can validate control execution.
- Retention: The raw logs are retained per contract for 12 months; older data requires a retrieval request.

Drive link for extended evidence: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/soc2/sentinel-2026-evidence (read-only). If you need write access or a zipped bundle for upload into your audit portal, tell us preferred method.

Attachments: redwood_key_rotation_summary_2025-2026.pdf, saml_assertion_samples.txt, redwood_mfa_log_sample_202610.csv, redwood_bridge_letter_draft.pdf

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sentinelhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: audits@sentinelhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-03T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II evidence packet & supplemental artifacts request

Laura / Jonas — thank you, this is exactly what we needed and the samples look good. A few quick follow-ups: 

- The 24-hour UTC slice is perfect.
- The redactions are acceptable for now; we'll request any re-identification under a formal DPA amendment if the auditors require it.
- Please provide the signed bridge letter PDF when ready (DocuSign is preferred).
- For our records, could you confirm the person who will sign the bridge letter (name and title)?

If you can get the signed letter by EOD 2026-11-05, we'll mark this vendor review as on-track and proceed to final control testing.

Thanks again — we'll close the loop once the signed PDF is uploaded to the shared Drive or attached in reply.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Sr. Procurement & Audit Manager
Sentinel Health
